creativeengineering.ponder.cementation.t: A Mechanical Press over a Basin packs iron into carbon
One iron ingot and two coal or charcoal make Carbon-Packed Iron
Coke is four times better: two iron and one coke make two
A fan blowing through lava bakes everything in its air stream: Bulk Blasting
Carbon-Packed Iron comes out as Blister Steel
A lit Blaze Burner works in place of lava. A vanilla Blast Furnace can do it too, one at a time
creativeengineering.ponder.coke_oven.hea: Coking Coal in a Coke Oven
creativeengineering.ponder.coke_oven.tex: Coke Oven Bricks placed together form one oven, up to 3 wide and 3 tall
Every brick adds four coking slots: bigger ovens coke more at once
It needs heat below every column. Fire or magma works at half speed, a Blaze Burner at full speed, superheated at double
Funnels, hoppers, belts and arms feed it from any side
Coal comes out as Coal Coke, logs as Charcoal. Pulling from it only ever takes finished items
While it cokes, smoke rises from the top and it crackles. Embers along the bottom just mean it has heat
Coking also gives Creosote Oil. Pump it from any brick. When the tank is full the rest vents in a dark burst, and the oven keeps going
